entries.title: What you type appears in a handwritten-style face
entries.body: Your own words, meaning your messages in Chat, the chat box and the fields on your profile page, are shown in a slightly handwritten typeface. Before, they looked almost the same as the app's own text; now what you wrote stands apart from what the article and the AI wrote.

entries.title: The Spideryarn picture is redrawn and larger
entries.body: The reading figure in the Spideryarn logo has been redrawn with thinner, more spread-out upper limbs. The icon in your browser tab and on a phone home screen is cropped so the figure fills more of it and reads larger; the logo in the app and the picture shown when you share a link use the new drawing too.

entries.title: Fewer typefaces across the app
entries.body: The links that point to a passage, and code shown in Chat answers, now use the one typewriter-style face the app already uses for code, instead of two others. In gift emails, the Spideryarn name is set in a plain sans-serif face, matching the website, rather than a serif.
